commits.title: Renderer: shade only the fragments each pass keeps

merged_maintenance.authorship: PR author and merger benediamond; all four substantive commits credit Claude Fable 5.2 as coauthor. No new rbajaj5 credit in these commit messages or PR body; no contribution-tally increment for this monitoring.

source_changes.finding: A shared dropped(alpha) function implements opaque/peeled-layer and projection-box dissolve tests. Divisor-visible scenes now make a cheap depth-only draw then shade where depth equals the prepass. Scenes without a divisor remain one draw per pass.

Degree and coefficient bounds select plain arithmetic for eligible expressions (degree at most 6, coefficient bounds within 2^±60); other expressions retain shared power-of-two exponent arithmetic. D jets carry two screen-direction derivatives; F jets carry four sphere-direction derivatives. The source still caps generated expressions at 4,096 nodes. Reading this implementation does not establish numerical correctness.
The bounded Newton projection remains capped at four iterations but stops when correction size is below 2.4e-7 (described upstream as two units in the last place).

contact_and_trace_scope: The post reports normalized trace coefficients on three sheets through the coupled nodal seed over F23[v]/(v^2-15), a characteristic-zero formula and a Lean matrix proof.

A nonzero seven-by-seven minor is reported to exclude using those three sheets alone even with arbitrary regular input differential, all eight odd-odd polynomial-exact directions and the stated rational chart corrections.

Conic/cubic residue representatives and a Bezout combination reportedly confine complementary poles to a fixed finite set on the normalized parameter curve. Boundary principal parts, normalized source matching and a global rational correction remain.

The nine-parameter model reports 115 distinct certified solutions at (r,s)=(1/10,1) and at least 440 moving coordinates after symmetry. A combination matching the target on thirteen sheets at one point fails at a nearby r+10^-14; this is not a full-component trace.

The smooth contact at (4,2) over 11 has reported single-sheet source (9,9,6), rank-48 spanning minor, and rank/dominance criteria. Its relation to the component studied over 23 is explicitly unidentified.

The marked-chart checks concern a specified complete two-parameter plane and a mod-11 seed: a single simple geometric solution, intermediate algebra rank 480, no weighted-infinity points, and a seven-by-seven residual Jacobian determinant 1. These local/slice statements do not enumerate the global moving family.
arithmetic_and_support_scope: The author reports a nonzero Frobenius slope-two component at 11,17,23 and full 48-by-48 Cartier-matrix recovery at 11. With a vertical-divisor argument the reported exclusion concerns primitives whose fiber poles are confined to branch, zero and infinity; the contact current has additional poles.

A support/resultant strategy would compute a polynomial containing the projected swept surface and its sign translate, then solve linear numerator equations for each denominator power. The author has not recovered a usable denominator or the required numerators.
The exact rational solver and reported finite-search obstructions are described in the post. No solver was run by this monitor.

A rank-12 obstruction reportedly excludes a primitive using only the derivative in E=H(1,r,c,d) with arbitrary rational coefficients in r,E. A one-point F11 interpolation recovers dlog(F) for a smooth genus-four contact; extending it to the curve parametrizing all contacts remains open.
